title: FilterExpression
description: Represents a structure for defining parameter conditions. Supported conditions are described here: Supported conditions for dynamic datasets in the Glue DataBrew Developer Guide.

allOf.description: The expression which includes condition names followed by substitution variables, possibly grouped and combined with other conditions. For example, "(starts_with :prefix1 or starts_with :prefix2) and (ends_with :suffix1 or ends_with :suffix2)". Substitution variables should start with ':' symbol.
The map of substitution variable names to their values used in this filter expression.
